purpose: The prescribed analytic clip-corner fixture, followed only after proof-complete replay by the preselected DDWMR single query. Not the matched-batch profile.

memory_enforcement.mechanism: Windows Job Object JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_PROCESS_MEMORY and JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; the IVP worker is created suspended, assigned to the job, then resumed
memory_enforcement.scope: one worker process containing producer, independent native replay, tamper checks, and the single common predicate check
memory_enforcement.timeout_mechanism: parent monotonic-clock deadline; terminate the complete job on expiry

probe.acceptance: graceful MemoryError after retained chunks approach the installed limit; reported peak is at least 75 percent of the cap and no greater than the cap

rational_precision: exact reduced rationals capped at 32768 bits for every numerator, denominator, and checked intermediate
rhs_jacobian_evaluation_scope: combined producer, native checker replay, and every proof tamper replay; reject before an evaluation that would exceed the cap; the common collision/contact predicate performs no RHS or Jacobian evaluation

transcendental_profile.range_reduction: none; exact rational Taylor polynomial plus global Lagrange remainder; broad range means UNKNOWN

residual_solver_profile.method: linear approximate path with exact rational slope; Auer residual derivative iteration and mean-value interval Jacobian on one complete closed slab
residual_solver_profile.initial_residual_seed: for analytic fixture, x residual derivative {0} and y derivative [-1,1]; for DDWMR, symmetric residual interval centered at zero with radius 1 plus the absolute initial RHS-minus-path-slope bound per component; fixed before the IVP
residual_solver_profile.iteration_acceptance: accept only when every newly recomputed residual-derivative interval is a subset of the previous interval and the derived full-time remainder is a subset of its rough predecessor
residual_solver_profile.subdivision: if inclusion fails, retain the rejected trial and bisect the time slab; action and complete fixed-label image remain unchanged
residual_solver_profile.contact_or_collision_failure: proof may remain complete; common predicate becomes UNKNOWN_ON_SUPPLIED_TUBE and is not called a safety certificate

retry_semantics: No cap, precision, tolerance, model, input, or action changes. Only deterministic time bisection under the frozen step/rejection limits is allowed.
stopping_semantics: Any process memory cap, timeout, rational cap, work cap, unresolved inclusion, unsupported operation, or failed replay stops the case without a proof-complete result; exact termination classification is retained.
selection_and_order: DDWMR query only if independent analytic native-proof replay and exact-reference containment pass
never select another query from outcome
